text:
sam_gtm: Starting thread for CoralEdge co-sell POC asks: private-tenant short trial, pricing for reserved capacity, SSQ status, and onboarding steps.

toni_se: CoralEdge legal emailed a long SSQ and wants VPC peering + BYOK in prod. For pilot theyre open to redwood KMS if keys are ephemeral. Need to confirm telemetry endpoints.

emma_ps: I'll take SSQ responses. What format do they want audit artifacts in? They asked for a redacted SOC2 report and a short controls matrix.

rahul_ops: For the private-tenant trial: infra can provision a constrained tenant for 10 business days if they prepay a baseline node charge. We'll need an operations runbook and a teardown checklist.

kevin_arch: Perf ask from partner: sustained 60 rps at 256 tokens with p50 latency <0.18s/token. That maps to a small dedicated pool + caching. Ballpark cost: $26k-$40k/mo depending on committed GPUs and region. (very rough).

sam_gtm: Can we offer a 10-day trial with no long-term commit to unblock procurement? They want to validate SSO + telemetry first.

rahul_ops: Yes but we require a signed pilot addendum and prepayment for baseline capacity ($3k for the trial). Ops will log IPs and quotas.

toni_se: CoralEdge insists on SSO before we ingest any sample data. They use Azure AD (SAML) and want SCIM provisioning. Can we share the minimal SAML/SCIM template?

infra-bot: SAML template snippet:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.prod/saml">
  <!-- ACS: https://console.redwood.prod/saml/acs -->
  <!-- X509 cert, singleLogoutService -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Also SCIM base: POST /scim/v2/Users with bearer token.

emma_ps: I'll bundle SOC2 redacted + controls matrix. We also need to confirm retention windows: default logs 72h, traces 30d; can extend for enterprise with cost. Clarify with CoralEdge if they need SIEM forwarders (Splunk/Datadog).

kevin_arch: On networking: ask for their VPC CIDRs and whether they require private peering or transit gateway. Also note egress IPs differ by region; ops will provide the list.

sam_gtm: Action list: 1) Emma = SSQ + SOC2 pack, 2) Rahul = trial tenant provisioning + pricing addendum, 3) Kevin = perf estimate + runbook, 4) Toni = collect IdP metadata & SCIM settings. I'll coordinate legal.

toni_se: CoralEdge will try redwood KMS for the trial. They will share Azure AD metadata by EOD. SCIM = yes. They asked if we support HSM for BYOK in prod.

rahul_ops: We support BYOK/HSM in Private mode for production; pilot can be redwood-managed with key export disabled. Ops needs an SLA doc signed if they want key persistence beyond the pilot.

kevin_arch: I'll prepare a short perf sim: load plan + expected instance sizing + KV cache tuning. Will post numbers here tomorrow.

emma_ps: Also suggest running initial onboarding against hosted private-tenancy feature flags to speed up auth and telemetry tests, then flip to dedicated if performance requires it.

sam_gtm: Good idea. If we can get the trial signed and IdP meta, we should schedule a 45-min enablement session next week to walk SCIM, telemetry, and access controls.

toni_se: I'll block time with CoralEdge once I have the metadata. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

rahul_ops: Noted. I'll add the teardown timers and costs to the runbook.

sam_gtm: Closing for now; will post the pilot addendum and the onboarding calendar invite here.
